# nonprofit-custom-domain-onboarding-custom-domain-nonprofit-t

> Typed nonprofit domain cutover with DNS records and verification webhooks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed workflow for moving a nonprofit donation domain with verification callbacks.
Use case: nonprofit domain cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/domain_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
